events.headline: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO valuation
events.summary: Anthropic is marketing 825 million shares at $70-$78, potentially raising $64.4 billion, plus a separate $26 billion placement. Its filing reports $81 billion run-rate revenue and nearly $900 billion in compute commitments.

events.headline: TSMC approves up to $1 billion of Anthropic and OpenAI investments
events.summary: TSMC's board authorized up to $500 million each for Anthropic IPO shares and OpenAI preferred shares, giving the chip manufacturer equity exposure to its AI ecosystem.

events.headline: Microsoft overtakes Nvidia by market capitalization
events.summary: Microsoft moved ahead of Nvidia as Nvidia fell more than 6% amid AI demand concerns and an investigation related to its CEO. The market-cap ranking reflects relative stock performance, not operating results.

events.headline: Nvidia decline deepens amid inflation and AI financing concerns
events.summary: Nvidia fell about 6.5% and neocloud providers weakened as hotter US inflation raised rate-hike expectations and investors questioned AI project financing. CoreWeave was due to report after the close.

events.headline: CoreWeave targets adjusted profitability in first half of 2028
events.summary: CoreWeave reported third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, up nearly 170%, and a $132.5 billion backlog. It expects adjusted profitability in 2028 but had $46.9 billion in debt at September-end.

events.headline: Asian stocks rise while bond yields jump after hot US inflation
events.summary: CoreWeave's results supported Asian equities and Nasdaq futures, while stronger-than-expected US core inflation raised expectations of December Fed tightening. Treasury yields and the dollar rose as gold weakened.

events.headline: Goldman Sachs adds March Fed hike to its forecast
events.summary: After a third consecutive upside US inflation surprise, Goldman Sachs forecast an additional 25-basis-point increase in March alongside a December hike, and pushed its expected first rate cut to December 2027.

events.headline: China's Singles Day tests AI shopping agents and consumer robots
events.summary: Alibaba, JD.com and other platforms expanded AI-assisted shopping. JD reported nearly 80 million users of its shopping assistant, while Alibaba said AI companion robot sales rose nearly fivefold year over year in late October.

events.headline: Foreign investors withdrew nearly $50 billion from Asian equities in October
events.summary: LSEG data showed $49.77 billion in net foreign equity outflows from seven Asian markets in October amid AI cash-burn and regulation worries, including large withdrawals from Taiwan and South Korea.

events.headline: India approves $7.34 billion high-voltage power corridor
events.summary: India approved a proposed 1,150-kV electricity transmission network to carry renewable generation to industrial centers, with an estimated six-year buildout and 688 billion rupee cost.
